teacher_source: S17B frozen baseline; teacher selected using historical source validation

summary.weighting: equal observed day cell means per TX/RX, then equal RX lower quartile
summary.missing_support: not imputed; observed days/RX can differ across TX

artifacts.tail_definition: Residual circular filter impulse energy outside +/-4 samples
artifacts.interpretation: Spectral counterfactual may ring in time; these are not identified receiver hardware filters

controls.role: diagnostic only; not subtracted from q and not used to choose masks

summary.truth_labels_scope: Only source-training evidence and offline teacher scoring; never model inference
